title: Fairfax's India playbook: How IDBI, Digit, IIFL, CSB fit into Watsa's plan
summary: Fairfax's USD 5.6-billion IDBI Bank acquisition, also India's largest FDI deal, is set to reshape Prem Watsa's India financial-services portfolio, with Digit and IIFL Capital proposed to come under IDBI while their operations remain decentralised. CSB Bank and IIFL Finance, however, remain outside the announced structure, requiring separate decisions. “We never believed in synergies. We believe in decentralised operation. That's one of the reasons for our success,” Watsa said.
